M000687.name: Kweisi Mfume
M000687.bio: Democratic U.S. Representative from Maryland, first from 1987 to 1996 and again since a 2020 special election. In between he led the NAACP.

M001232.name: April McClain Delaney
M001232.bio: Democratic U.S. Representative for Maryland's 6th district from 2025.
